## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. "It's hard to track Ph.D. scholars because...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the implementation.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Impact & Dependencies
- Which modules are affected? (e.g. Module 9 - Research & Innovation, Module 14 - Score Engine)
- Does this require database schema updates (DynamoDB/Aurora)?
- Does this introduce new external APIs or library dependencies?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup drawings, or user stories here.
